model.purpose: Register immutable model releases, derive context-qualified installability and assurance, gate canonical status with evidence and holds, and withdraw new use without destroying reproducibility.
model.scope: This companion owns five release-acceptance records only. It references WM-XCT-013 for registry acts and history, WM-XCT-040 for dependency closure and staging receipts, and model-publication/v1 for catalogue projection. It does not own registry constitution, dependency graphs, package storage, catalogue records, signatures, identity, IAM or source-of-truth business models.
inScope: derived status predicates at a time and target context

functions.name: Register release coordinate
functions.description: Accept a model/version only when it binds exactly one verified package digest and pinned registry/resolution references.

functions.name: Assess release
functions.description: Record a profile-, tool-, fixture- and evidence-pinned assessment without mutating release bytes.

functions.name: Derive release status
functions.description: Compute existence, installability, assurance, canonical status, new-install eligibility and discoverability for a target context and time.

functions.name: Dispose publication hold
functions.description: Append an authorized resolution, waiver or supersession while retaining the hold history.

functions.name: Withdraw new use
functions.description: Reference a WM-XCT-013 withdrawal act, stop selected new-use scopes and preserve all exact historical locks.

composition.limits: Semantic references only; no executable parent import or standards conformance claim.

invariants: A registered (modelId, version) maps to exactly one packageByteDigest.
A package byte digest and a semantic fingerprint are different claims and never substitute for one another.
A mutable branch, tag, wildcard, latest token or unbound URL is never an exact lock.
Installability is derived for one target context from verified bytes and a successful WM-XCT-040 receipt; it does not imply assurance or approval.
Assurance binds one package digest to a pinned assessment profile, pinned tool artifacts, a frozen fixture set and retained evidence.
Canonical status is a derived predicate at time t and is never a user-set field on ModelRelease.
An open blocking hold affects only its declared scopes and overrides a stale catalogue projection.
Assessment revocation or supersession is append-only and cannot rewrite prior evidence.
Withdrawal references a WM-XCT-013 act and never becomes a competing history ledger.
Withdrawal never deletes released bytes, evidence, receipts or the transitive closure required by a prior exact lock.
Release existence survives withdrawal; current canonical status, new-install eligibility and discoverability are separate predicates.
A dependency withdrawal does not rewrite dependants; prior locks remain reproducible and new closures must be re-evaluated.

publicationHolds: This is a bounded Vercy companion and reference gate, not universal package-manager, supply-chain or standards conformance.
The first release has no native V3 Dimension binding; consumers use the JSON schema and reference evaluator.
Semantic fingerprints require an adopting canonicalization profile; this package supplies a fixture profile, not a universal semantic hashing standard.
Registry, resolver, storage, signer, IAM and catalogue authority remain external and must be independently authenticated.
WM-XCT-013 upstream source-version and historic single-provider holds remain visible; this profile does not cure them.
